# rlit_cli

- purpose: Shared Rust library crate providing the r_lit CLI machine-call contract (JSON envelope, exit codes, `__schema` export) and dual-sink `runlog` sidecar logging
- version: 0.1.0
- contract_version: 1
- spec: docs/cli-contract.md
- adopted_by: mj_atlas, img_resize, ui-trim, textexture, bulk_upload

## Public API

- `Contract::parse` / `Contract::parse_from` — handles `__schema`, tracks `--json`, captures subcommand path
- `set_data`, `add_artifact`, `warn`, `set_failure`, `set_failure_code`, `finish`, `finish_ok`
- `schema_for`, `check_contract`
- `runlog::init`, `runlog::flush`, `runlog::standard_header`, `runlog::standard_header_for`
- `ErrorKind`: Runtime(1), Usage(2), Input(3), External(4), Partial(5)
